mathematical_definition: Numba kernel breakout_failure_magnitude(close, high, low, window=20, lookback=5): if the high broke the trailing 20-bar high at any point within the last 5 bars, how far (fractionally) has price since retraced back below that broken level; 0 if no breakout occurred or the breakout is still holding
missing_value_policy: 0.0 for the first 25 bars (window=20 + lookback=5, per the kernel's own loop start) and 0.0 whenever no qualifying breakout is found or the breakout still holds -- the kernel never emits NaN, it zero-fills by construction
